timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Quantum physics explores the behavior of particles at the subatomic level, revealing
strange and unpredictable phenomena. One of the key principles is superposition, where
particles can exist in multiple states simultaneously until observed. Intanglement is another fascinating
concept, linking the properties of particles even when separated by vast distances. Quantum
mechanics challenges our classical intuition, introducing uncertainty and probability into
the fabric of reality. Despite its perplexing nature, quantum physics underlies the foundation
of modern technology, from computers to medical advancements.
